newsitem.title: USA: Sara Lee to sell stake in Aris Isotoner.
newsitem.headline: Sara Lee to sell stake in Aris Isotoner.

text.p: Sara Lee Corp. said Thursday its Aris Isotoner glove and slipper unit will join the umbrella and boot maker, totes inc., in a new joint venture called totes Isotoner.
The investment firm Bain Capital Inc. controls totes.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed, but Sara Lee said it will retain an ownership in the new venture.
John H. Bryan, Sara Lee chairman and chief executive officer, said Aris Isotoner's products were no longer a core focus for the company.
"We have determined that its greatest opportunity for profitable growth will come from an integration into totes," he said.
Sara Lee markets a variety of consumer products ranging from sausages to underwear under brand names that include Sara Lee, Ball Park, Jimmy Dean, Hanes and Playtex.
Sara Lee's stock gained 37.5 cents to $40.625 in early trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
